Spider_4.output:
```sql
WITH ranked_departments AS (
    SELECT 
        department_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_employees,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk
    FROM employees
    GROUP BY department_id
)
SELECT AVG(num_employees) AS avg_employees
FROM ranked_departments
WHERE rnk BETWEEN 10 AND 15;
```
